company.name: World Labs
company.shortDescription: World Labs develops artificial intelligence systems designed to understand, generate, and interact with three-dimensional environments.
company.description: World Labs builds spatial intelligence models that convert visual and textual inputs into structured 3D representations capable of reasoning about objects, space, and movement. Its product Marble generates persistent 3D worlds from inputs such as text, images, video, and panoramic media, enabling users to explore, edit, and expand digital environments. The platform supports interactive editing and the combination of multiple spatial scenes while maintaining consistent geometry and visual structure. World Labs’ technology is applied in workflows related to digital media creation, simulation, gaming, robotics, architecture, and other fields that require modeling or interaction with three-dimensional environments. The company also provides documentation and development resources that allow users to build and experiment with spatial AI systems.
